name: Tooltip
description: A popup that displays informational text when hovering over or focusing a trigger element. Built on Radix UI Tooltip primitive. The content is portaled and features entrance/exit animations with directional slide-in based on placement side.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the tooltip.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the open state changes.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: The delay in milliseconds before the tooltip opens on hover (set on TooltipProvider).

subComponents.name: TooltipProvider
subComponents.description: Wraps your application or a section of it to provide shared tooltip configuration (e.g., delay duration, skip delay). Must be an ancestor of all Tooltip instances.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: The global delay in milliseconds before tooltips open.

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description: How much time a user has to enter another trigger without incurring a delay again.

props.name: disableHoverableContent
props.description: When true, the tooltip closes immediately when the pointer leaves the trigger.

subComponents.name: Tooltip
subComponents.description: The root component that manages the open/closed state of an individual tooltip.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Override the provider's delay for this specific tooltip.

subComponents.name: TooltipTrigger
subComponents.description: The element that triggers the tooltip on hover or focus. Renders as a Radix Tooltip Trigger.

props.name: asChild
props.description: When true, merges props onto the child element instead of rendering a button.

subComponents.name: TooltipContent
subComponents.description: The content popup displayed when the tooltip is open. Rendered via a portal with animations (fade-in, zoom-in, directional slide-in based on side). Styled with rounded-md border, bg-popover, shadow-md, and text-sm.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: The distance in pixels between the trigger and the tooltip content.

props.name: side
props.description: The preferred side of the trigger to render the content.

props.name: align
props.description: The alignment of the content relative to the trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with default content styles.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to focus the trigger element, which opens the tooltip. Escape closes the tooltip. The tooltip also opens on hover.
accessibility.aria: Managed by Radix UI: role=tooltip on content, aria-describedby on trigger linking to the tooltip content.
accessibility.notes: TooltipProvider must wrap all Tooltip instances. Use asChild on TooltipTrigger when wrapping custom elements like buttons or icons. The content is portaled to avoid clipping.
